chapter_title: The Apostle is asked: Why when you drew every thing in the Picture (- Book), did you not draw the Purification of the Catechumens who shall be cleansed by Transmigration?
chapter_note: This chapter contains no detectable oldest-layer cosmological-correspondential substrate. Teaching purity is 0.000 with zero substrate vocabulary across all paragraphs. The entire chapter is institutional/editorial material concerning the Manichaean Picture-Book (a community artifact), the catechumenate system, the elect/catechumen distinction, and transmigration as institutional soteriology. The cosmological elements present (Judge, land of light, gehenna) are generic eschatological furniture used in service of institutional discussion, not systematic cosmic-domain mappings.
